summary: The agent successfully completed a harbor receiving exception audit task involving Excel data processing with pandas/openpyxl and Word document generation. Key learnings: (1) pandas read_excel can misinterpret string 'None' as NaN - verify with openpyxl directly when accuracy matters, (2) openpyxl provides more reliable low-level cell value inspection than pandas for verification, (3) multi-sheet Excel files with formatting require careful sheet-by-sheet construction. Creating a skill for Excel audit report generation with pandas/openpyxl patterns and common pitfalls.
